cases.name: natural-language-plan-tables
cases.inputs: Plan my Workday time entries for the week starting Aug 10 2026: 11 hours Monday and 8 hours Tuesday. Use the activity file at .claude/skills/workday-timelogger/evals/fixtures/activity-2026-08-10.yaml (today is Aug 15 2026). Just show me the plan tables, do not open the browser or enter anything. Write the plan to /tmp/wl-eval-nl.json.

metadata.why: Same data phrased in prose: the skill has to recognise plan-only intent, run the planner, and present the two tables in the documented shape.

ClaudeCLIJudge.rubric:
Grade the response text only.

FAIL if any rule is violated:
1. It contains TWO markdown tables. The first has one column each for the day (or date), the entry type (Reg/Extra), the hours, and the comment (a column named Comment, Tickets or similar counts). The second has one column for the issue ref and one for its title (header names may vary).
2. The first table has exactly three data rows: Monday Reg 8, Monday Extra 3, Tuesday Reg 8 (dates may be rendered as 'Mon 08/10' or similar).
3. Every Comment cell is non-empty.
4. The second table lists at least four distinct issue refs of the form repo#number.
5. The response does not claim that anything was entered, submitted or opened in Workday, and does not report a browser being launched.
